title: Live Paper Trading

targets.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "lean_chart" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live' AND "chart" = 'Strategy Equity'
SELECT last("cash") FROM "lean_portfolio" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live'
SELECT last("total_holdings_value") FROM "lean_portfolio" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live'
SELECT last("total_unrealized_profit") FROM "lean_portfolio" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live'
SELECT "value" FROM "lean_chart" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live' AND "chart" = 'Strategy Equity'
SELECT "drawdown" FROM "barra_cne5_daily" WHERE $timeFilter AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live'

panels.title: 组合价值 / 净利润 / 手续费

targets.query: SELECT "total_portfolio_value" FROM "lean_portfolio" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live'
SELECT "total_net_profit" FROM "lean_portfolio" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live'
SELECT "total_fees" FROM "lean_portfolio" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live'

panels.title: 持仓数量 / 股票数量

targets.query: SELECT "holdings" FROM "barra_cne5_factor_exposure" WHERE $timeFilter AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live'
SELECT "total_shares" FROM "barra_cne5_daily" WHERE $timeFilter AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live'

SELECT last("quantity") AS "quantity", last("average_price") AS "avg_price", last("market_price") AS "market_price", last("holdings_value") AS "value", last("unrealized_profit") AS "pnl", last("unrealized_profit_percent") AS "pnl_pct", last("holdings_cost") AS "cost", last("net_profit") AS "net_profit", last("total_fees") AS "total_fees", last("total_sale_volume") AS "sale_vol" FROM "barra_cne5_holding_detail" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live' AND "quantity" > 0 GROUP BY "symbol"

SELECT "fill_quantity" AS "fill_qty", "fill_price" AS "fill_price", "fee_amount" AS "fee", "quantity" AS "order_qty", "order_id" AS "order_id" FROM "lean_order_event" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live' AND "status" = 'Filled' GROUP BY "symbol", "direction" ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT last("numeric_value") FROM "lean_metric" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live' AND "category" = 'runtime' AND "metric" = 'Return'
SELECT last("numeric_value") FROM "lean_metric" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live' AND "category" = 'runtime' AND "metric" = 'Net Profit'
SELECT last("numeric_value") FROM "lean_metric" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live' AND "category" = 'runtime' AND "metric" = 'Total Fees'
SELECT last("numeric_value") FROM "lean_metric" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live' AND "category" = 'runtime' AND "metric" = 'Kelly'
SELECT last("numeric_value") FROM "lean_metric" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live' AND "category" = 'runtime' AND "metric" = 'Target Exp'
SELECT last("numeric_value") FROM "lean_metric" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live' AND "category" = 'runtime' AND "metric" = 'Score Spr'
SELECT last("numeric_value") FROM "lean_metric" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live' AND "category" = 'runtime' AND "metric" = 'Probabilistic Sharpe Ratio'
SELECT last("numeric_value") FROM "lean_metric" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live' AND "category" = 'runtime' AND "metric" = 'Holdings'
SELECT last("numeric_value") FROM "lean_metric" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live' AND "category" = 'runtime' AND "metric" = 'Signals'
SELECT last("numeric_value") FROM "lean_metric" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live' AND "category" = 'runtime' AND "metric" = 'Fees'
SELECT last("numeric_value") FROM "lean_metric" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live' AND "category" = 'runtime' AND "metric" = 'Unrealized'
SELECT last("numeric_value") FROM "lean_metric" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live' AND "category" = 'runtime' AND "metric" = 'Volume'
SELECT last("numeric_value") FROM "lean_metric" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live' AND "category" = 'runtime' AND "metric" = 'MC'
SELECT last("numeric_value") FROM "lean_metric" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live' AND "category" = 'runtime' AND "metric" = 'OOS'
SELECT last("numeric_value") FROM "lean_metric" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live' AND "category" = 'runtime' AND "metric" = 'OOS Period'
SELECT last("numeric_value") FROM "lean_metric" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live' AND "category" = 'runtime' AND "metric" = 'Last Session'
SELECT last("value") FROM "lean_chart" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live' AND "chart" = 'Strategy Equity' AND "series" = 'Equity'

SELECT mean("beta") AS "Beta", mean("momentum") AS "动量", mean("size") AS "规模", mean("earnyld") AS "盈利收益率", mean("resvol") AS "残差波动率", mean("growth") AS "成长性", mean("btop") AS "价值", mean("leverage") AS "杠杆", mean("liquidity") AS "流动性", mean("nlsize") AS "非线性规模", mean("moneyflow") AS "资金流", mean("quality") AS "质量", mean("northbound") AS "北向资金", mean("margin") AS "边际信号", mean("chipcost") AS "筹码成本" FROM "barra_cne5_factor_exposure" WHERE $timeFilter AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live' GROUP BY time(1m)

SELECT "fill_quantity" AS "fill_qty", "fill_price" AS "fill_price", "fee_amount" AS "fee", "order_id" AS "order_id" FROM "lean_order_event" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live' AND "status" = 'Filled' GROUP BY "symbol", "direction" ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Sharpe 衰减
panels.description: 短期(1h) Sharpe - 长期 Sharpe，负值表示性能衰减

targets.query: SELECT last("sharpe_decay") FROM "barra_cne5_decay" WHERE $timeFilter AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live'

panels.title: 收益率衰减
panels.description: 短期(1h) 收益率 - 长期收益率，负值表示性能衰减

targets.query: SELECT last("return_decay") FROM "barra_cne5_decay" WHERE $timeFilter AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live'

panels.title: 当前回撤
panels.description: 当前权益相对历史峰值的回撤百分比

targets.query: SELECT last("drawdown") FROM "barra_cne5_decay" WHERE $timeFilter AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live'
SELECT last("max_drawdown") FROM "barra_cne5_decay" WHERE $timeFilter AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live'

panels.title: 滚动 Sharpe Ratio
panels.description: 不同时间窗口的年化 Sharpe Ratio，短期下降表示策略衰减

targets.query: SELECT mean("sharpe_1h") AS "sharpe_1h", mean("sharpe_6h") AS "sharpe_6h", mean("sharpe_all") AS "sharpe_all" FROM "barra_cne5_decay" WHERE $timeFilter AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live' GROUP BY time($__interval)

panels.title: 滚动收益率
panels.description: 不同时间窗口的累计收益率(%)，短期低于长期表示策略衰减

targets.query: SELECT mean("return_1h") AS "return_1h", mean("return_6h") AS "return_6h", mean("return_all") AS "return_all" FROM "barra_cne5_decay" WHERE $timeFilter AND "algorithm_id" = '$algorithm_id' AND "mode" = 'live' GROUP BY time($__interval)
